sql:
WITH store_product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        fos.StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName,
        fos.ProductKey,
        dp.ProductName,
        sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS product_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds ON fos.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS dp ON fos.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
    WHERE toYear(fos.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY
        fos.StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName,
        fos.ProductKey,
        dp.ProductName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        StoreName,
        ProductKey,
        ProductName,
        product_sales,
        sum(product_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey) AS store_total_sales,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY product_sales DESC, ProductKey) AS product_rank
    FROM store_product_sales
)
SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    product_rank,
    ProductKey,
    ProductName,
    product_sales AS sales_amount,
    product_sales / nullIf(store_total_sales, 0) AS sales_share_of_store
FROM ranked
WHERE product_rank <= 3
ORDER BY StoreKey, product_rank
